name: Johann Sebastian Bach
hook: The Baroque master of the fugue and the organ — and father of 20 children.

facts.label: the organ
facts.statement: Bach was a master of the organ and wrote a "Little Book" of 45 chorales for the instrument.

facts.label: The Well-Tempered Clavier
facts.statement: In 1722 Bach completed the first book of The Well-Tempered Clavier; the full set runs to 48 preludes and fugues for the clavier.

facts.label: Brandenburg Concertos
facts.statement: The Brandenburg Concertos are six concertos that Bach dedicated in 1721 to Christian Ludwig, Margrave of Brandenburg.

facts.label: the fugue
facts.statement: Bach was a master of the fugue, a polyphonic form he paired with a toccata in D minor and explored in The Art of Fugue in 1749.
associations: Toccata and Fugue in D minor

facts.label: Eisenach
facts.statement: Bach grew up in Eisenach, Germany, and the Baroque era is said to have ended with his death in 1750.

facts.label: 20 children
facts.statement: Bach had 20 children, among them the composers Carl Philipp Emanuel Bach and Johann Christian Bach.

facts.label: Handel
facts.statement: Bach and Handel were born weeks apart in 1685, a few dozen miles apart, but never met.
